environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in us-east-1, task role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/app-service-role with s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, and no permission boundary attached. Container runs as root. ADMIN_TOKEN set via environment variable. ALB forwards all traffic on port 3000. No WAF attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
